descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor:

​Core Specifications

  • ​Total Cores: 6

  • ​Total Threads: 12

  • ​Base Clock: 3.6 GHz

  • ​Max Boost Clock: Up to 4.2 GHz

  • ​Architecture: Zen 2 (Matisse)

  • ​Process Technology: TSMC 7nm FinFET

  • ​TDP: 65W

  • ​**Unlocked for Overclocking: Yes

​Cache

  • ​L1 Cache: 384 KB

  • ​L2 Cache: 3 MB

  • ​L3 Cache: 32 MB

​Memory Specifications

  • ​System Memory Type: DDR4

  • ​Memory Channels: 2

  • ​System Memory Specification: Up to 3200 MT/s

​Connectivity & Graphics

  • ​PCI Express Version: PCIe 4.0 x16

  • ​Integrated Graphics: None (Discrete Graphics Card Required)

  • ​Socket: AM4

​Thermal Information

  • ​Max Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 95°C

  • ​Thermal Solution: AMD Wraith Stealth (included in boxed version)
